summary.result: As a result, attention has shifted from traditional, infrastructure-centered approaches to collaborative governance-based water management.
summary.background: In recent years, South Korea has institutionalized integrated water management through the enactment of the Framework Act on Water Management, the establishment of River Basin Water Management Committees, and the formulation of comprehensive basin management plans.
summary.method: The research focuses on the drivers of cooperation, the roles of key actors and institutions, the process of negotiation and consensus-building, and issues such as new intake facility construction and cost-sharing arrangements.
